entries.c8cad35fb5d619fd: As a consignee company of the Tokyo Metropolitan Central Wholesale Market under the Wholesale Market Act, it states that it will fulfill its social mission of "contributing to the healthy dietary life of the people" and aim for "conversion from a conventional consignee company to a sales company with extensive functions." In its medium-term management plan "MF-2026 (Move Forward 2026)," covering fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026, it sets as priority issues expansion of handling of fresh marine products and strengthening of the processing, manufacturing, and sales business for frozen marine products, strengthening of production-area processing and consumption-area processing, and streamlining of logistics, and states that it will work on increasing handling of marine products with consideration for marine resource protection and the environment, enhancing production-area processing and consumption-area processing, and utilizing facilities such as refrigerators within the Toyosu Market. Target figures for the plan are matters concerning the future, so they are not transcribed here.
